goal: Develop a network scanning tool that can discover devices on a network, identify open ports, and generate a report.
acceptance_criteria: The script must support scanning IP ranges using CIDR notation
The script must support specifying multiple ports to scan
The script must handle socket timeouts appropriately
The script must provide detailed logging for debugging
The script must output results in JSON format
All functions must be properly exported and accessible
Comprehensive test suite passes with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
